items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: The thing of it is to out do me he would write my parts way up high

ctx.x: style really. Trent was really a four-four style and it was all accent.

The thing of it is to out do me he would write my parts way up high, so I was determined not to let this guy laugh at me and I'd go ahead and make them as high as he--I seen him put them up to G, E flat, even if they're F and I made that F; scared him to death. It scared me when I first saw it.
Yeah, I can imagine, because the trombone was playing up like that.
